correctness.rationale: For all dimensions d>=3, r>0 and h>=0, Pythagorean projection yields the three transverse side squares. Heron gives 16A^2/s^4=3-4k^2+4uv. On acute projected triangles the circumradius squared is (1-z)((1+p)^2-z)/(3-4z+4p), with derivative 2(1-z)(2p+1)(p+1-2z)/(3-4z+4p)^2. The obtuse competitor decreases to its right boundary and cannot beat the following acute minimum. This proves the exact decreasing f(k), its three branches, and the unique crossing of h/k and r/f(k). Explicit transverse triangle construction proves every sharp value, and equality follows from unique minimizing products and enclosing-circle uniqueness. Rational identities and 2,000 witnesses, 77,088 grid cases, 132,000 spatial orientations were checked by the actual standalone verify.py included with this finding. The infinite result is proved analytically, not by finite trials.
